proposal.title: Cedar Canopy Forest
proposal.idea: A sun-dappled forest canopy filtered through horizontal cedar branches, creating a warm and ethereal visual experience.
proposal.geometry: A grid of tiered horizontal cedar branches, with a subtle gradient in their width and depth.
proposal.typography: The worship lyric band is set against a subtle gradient of warm and cool colors, with larger characters for emphasis.
proposal.imageLogic: Photographs of the cedar branches and forest floor are used as textures, with subtle lighting and shadows to create depth.
proposal.texture: The surface of the forest floor is textured with subtle light leaks and film grain, while the cedar branches have a subtle metallic sheen.
proposal.motion: The sun-dappled forest light shafts sway gently with the singer's voice, creating a sense of movement and emotion.
proposal.productionMethod: The forest canopy is rendered using generative image/video models with procedural code, with subtle lighting and shadows added to create depth.
proposal.humanTrace: The perceptible sign of making is the subtle textures and light leaks in the forest floor and cedar branches.
proposal.risk: The risk is that the visual may become too cluttered or busy, overwhelming the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live.
